an3.108:1.1: Tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhave paṭisevanāya n' atthi titti.
an3.108:1.3: Soppassa bhikkhave paṭisevanāya n' atthi titti,
an3.108:1.4: surāmerayapānassa bhikkhave paṭisevanāya n' atthi titti,
an3.108:1.5: methunadhammasamāpattiyā bhikkhave paṭisevanāya n' atthi titti.
an3.108:1.6: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ paṭisevanāya n' atthi tittī
